officialSources.observation: Official Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council BhuLekh portal loaded anonymously. The page describes statewide land records and links plot/gata-related land-record services. The current JavaScript identifies public API bases https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/api and https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/bhunaksha. No login, credentials, captcha bypass, or unsafe land fields were used.

Official Department of Land Resources page lists state/UT land-record services and explains Records of Rights, cadastral maps, spatial data, and ULPIN as separate concepts. It is national directory/procedure context, not Dalla-specific parcel coverage.

Search discovery returned the government-services catalogue entry describing district/subdivision/tehsil/village land-record selection. The result is a government catalogue lead and was not used as evidence that Dalla has a parcel response.
